title: Bound European type-4 tilemap streams
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Use the common original cell reader and per-mode dispatch to bound the 61 distinct type-4 streams referenced by the E445 and E446 inventories.
validation: Wine 9xsy1p68 authenticates the remaining dispatcher instructions. Wine 78zzrsqb confirms 844 of 7,380 stream bytes and 81 of 856 descriptor bytes have declared E301 owners. Both Wine servers drained.
limitations: The 51 unowned streams, mode-3 roots, other callers, ordinary use, integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No gameplay replay or performance comparison was made.
